sources.title: Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Language Models

sources.title: Top 15 Multimodal Models in 2026 (Open Source & Proprietary)
sources.snippet: What are multimodal models, in simple terms? Multimodal models are machine learning and artificial intelligence systems that process multiple data types (modalities) together. Instead of treating each data type separately, a large multimodal model learns joint representations so it can align visual cues, textual descriptions, and other modalities in a shared space.
